cells.heading: Cells
cells.notPushing: Does not push to this client
cells.note: Each cell pushes the people homed there and keeps its own queues; the pause is shared by every cell. An act in a cell’s row goes to that cell; the acts above go to every cell.
cells.withheld: its queued deliveries are not released to the cell you are signed in through.
detail.missing: There is no SCIM client “{client}” in this realm.
detail.notRead: Not read yet in this process. Test the connection to read it.
fields.cells: Cells that push to it (one per line; empty = every cell)
fields.cellsHeading: In a service deployed as cells
fields.groups: Selected groups (one per line, cn or DN)
fields.kept: left empty, the one set is kept
fields.name: Name
fields.scopeGroups: Groups whose members are pushed (one per line, cn or DN)
httpAllowed: Development mode with scimClient.allowHttp on: a client may dial a plain http:// service provider. Product mode refuses it.
lead: Each client pushes this realm’s people and groups to another identity provider’s SCIM 2.0 service as they change, with a retry queue and a dead-letter queue of its own. A client is an application entry; its credentials are sealed and never shown.
none: No SCIM client in this realm.
notLoaded: The outbound SCIM client is not loaded in this process.
queuesNote: A failing service provider pauses its client with an exponential backoff; one delivery goes first when the pause ends.
row.paused: Paused until {until} after {failures} failures in a row
